subject.title: fix(ui): show cross-agent child sessions in the sidebar on request

question: Should an explicit sidebar-local “All agents” action be allowed to reveal child/spawned session rows stored under other configured agent scopes?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally default-off and avoids a protocol/config change, but whether a user may widen sidebar discovery across configured agent stores is a product privacy and workflow boundary rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the sidebar-only opt-in
options.body: Accept cross-agent child-session discovery only after explicit user action, retaining the current scoped default and existing non-session exclusions.

options.title: Keep agent scopes isolated
options.body: Reject the wider sidebar visibility boundary and close or rescope the feature rather than exposing cross-agent child rows.

recommendation.title: Approve the sidebar-only opt-in
recommendation.body: Accept cross-agent child-session discovery only after explicit user action, retaining the current scoped default and existing non-session exclusions.
